_readme: Every editable slot on the Planetoño-based Marathon page. Edit values, then run: python3 -I tools/apply.py. Values still marked are the original copy, waiting for Marathon text. Mixed CaPs are intentional: the Futura Passata font draws upper and lower case letters in different styles.
